company.name: Optery
company.shortDescription: Optery is an opt-out software that removes your home address, phone number, email, and other private information from the Internet.
company.description:
Optery makes sure your home address, phone number, email address, and other private information are removed from the internet. They do this by opting you out of all the top data brokers that trade in this information and post it online. They cover over 225 data brokers, more than any other personal information removal service on the market. Optery prevents identity theft and fraud, reduces the surface area of attack for phishing attempts and spam, and removes private information from showing up in Google search results. Optery's mission is to put consumers in control of their personal data.

Anyone can create a free account to receive a personalized exposure report summarising where your information is posted online and being openly sold by data brokers.
